entries.wording: 货物电子信息已经收到
entries.note: The platform's own row for an order without scans.

entries.wording: Package received and scanned at warehouse到达收货点
entries.note: PWB's Shenzhen warehouse takes the parcel in, the English and the platform's Chinese run together. The kind code groups other arrivals.
The parcel leaves the warehouse. The kind code groups other departures.

entries.wording: Order information has been transmitted to DPD.
entries.note: PWB sends the order to DPD, its last-mile partner abroad, dated back to the day it did. It moves nothing, and names no DPD number.

entries.wording: 预计配载航班…月…日,Expected flight on …
entries.note: The flight the parcel is loaded for, naming its day in both halves ("11月11日", "November 11th"); the map reads each day as an ellipsis. The flight is still to come.

entries.wording: Package in transit to destination country
目的港已提货 Delivery has been made at the destination port
entries.note: Collected from the airline at the destination airport, before import clearance: not a delivery to the recipient.

entries.wording: Customs import clearance completed, awaiting pickup by local carrier
Package picked up by last-mile carrier
entries.note: The last-mile partner took the parcel over; its own tracking takes it from there.
